---
title: Fix specific weak exercise pictures
labels: images,bug
---

Pictures in `img/w/` that are still unclear or slightly wrong after review:

- [ ] **Slow step calf raise** (`ankle-slow-step-calf-raise`): START must show heels dropped clearly *below* the step edge.
- [ ] **Frog stretch rocks** (`frog-frog-stretch-rocks`): start and finish nearly identical. Try side view with knees wide, hips clearly forward vs back.
- [ ] **90/90 hip switches** (`ninety-90-90-hip-switches`): the 90° angles at both knees aren't obvious; add angle marks.
- [ ] **Archer pull-up** (`pull-archer-pull-up`): straight arm should run along the bar.
- [ ] **Archer push-up** (`push-archer-push-up`): straight arm should be clearly locked out to the side.
- [ ] **Straight bar dip** (`dip-straight-bar-dip`): must be one single bar, not parallel bars.
- [ ] **Diamond push-up** (`push-diamond-push-up`): hands should visibly form a diamond under the chest.
- [ ] **Scapular pull** (`pull-scapular-pull`): the movement is tiny; consider a close-up of shoulders/neck.

Tip: for small movements (calves, scapula, ankles) a close-up framing works much better than full body.
